title: Elevate UI Performance: Master CSS 'font-display' for Optimal Web Font Loading
tweet: Boost #WebPerformance & #UX with 'font-display'! Learn how to prevent FOUT/FOIT and ensure your #WebFonts load elegantly. A must-read for #CSS experts. #UITypography #WebDev
tip: Choosing the right 'font-display' strategy (like 'swap' or 'optional') is crucial for minimizing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and improving perceived performance. 'swap' is often a good default for critical fonts, while 'optional' offers maximum control for non-essential ones, respecting user bandwidth and preventing unnecessary downloads.
